candidate: Represent every unstable exact ReLU uniformly as y = slope*x + rho, with one bounded rho factor and the original exact binary/Big-M constraints retained.

method.implementation: process-local method replacement for build-only census; no repository source edit

instrumentation.reason: The first process-local unittest.mock autospec wrapper hid the _build_relu caller frame and therefore reproduced the baseline without applying the candidate. It entered no solver and is excluded from the candidate result.

decision.reason: Uniform residual coordinates carry preactivation sparse support through downstream affine layers. The build exceeded the full 30-second responsiveness budget before reaching the last two exact ReLU layers, versus roughly 2.5 seconds for the complete retained path.
